name: Quetzalcoatlus
position_note: Building-level point; the model stands in front of the main entrance.
description: Quetzalcoatlus northropi is one of the largest animals ever known to have flown. It was not a dinosaur but a pterosaur: a flying reptile from a neighbouring branch of the reptile family tree.

name: Three-toed horse
position_note: Indoor position is illustrative until checked against an official floor plan.
description: About ten million years ago a lake lay beside the Höwenegg volcano in the Hegau. Animals that died at its shore sank into fine lake mud, which preserved whole skeletons: three-toed horses, antelopes, rhinoceroses and more.
